name: Woodbine Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 233238 (111 days observed, edges closes)

booking.note: 8 sites are first-come, first-served (booked in person on site only; don't call); the rest are by reservation only on recreation.gov, up to 6 months ahead. The Forest Service says reservations close 24 hours before the stay; recreation.gov's rule is a 2-day cutoff. Outside the reserved season (in 2026, May 1-21 and September 11-30) recreation.gov's rate table lists first-come, first-served seasons. Late arrivals are held 24 hours. Concessionaire-run (recreation.gov contact camping@rrmofa.com).

note: Custer Gallatin NF (Beartooth RD), on the banks of the Stillwater River at 5,300 ft at the end of Stillwater River Road #2400, adjacent to the Absaroka-Beartooth Wilderness; 7 mi south of Nye, 57 mi west of Red Lodge. Wooded and shady. The 1.5-mile round-trip Woodbine Falls Trail starts in the campground; the Stillwater Trail (#24) reaches Sioux Charley Lake in 3 miles. Very popular on summer weekends and holidays. --Claude

name: Nash Fork Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 10250599 (85 days observed, edges closes)
note: USFS campground at ~10,200 ft along the Snowy Range Scenic Byway (WY-130) in Medicine Bow NF, ~10 mi W of Centennial. 24 sites, vault toilets, no water (pack in), no hookups; RVs to ~25 ft. Mix of reservable and first-come sites for 2026. Reservable online. --Claude

name: Ryan Park Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 231848 (130 days observed, edges closes)
note: Medicine Bow NF (Brush Creek/Hayden RD) 49-site campground at ~8,000 ft on the Snowy Range Scenic Byway near Barrett Creek; 13 pull-through/RV sites (to 30+ ft), vault toilets, potable water, no hookups; reservable on Recreation.gov, 14-day limit. --Claude

name: Silver Lake Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 10155962 (117 days observed, edges closes)
note: Medicine Bow NF (Brush Creek/Hayden RD), highest campground on the district beside the Snowy Range Scenic Byway on Silver Lake. 17 sites incl 3 RV pull-throughs for trailers under 32 ft; vault toilets, potable water, no hookups. Opens late June/early July. Reservable online. --Claude

name: Brooklyn Lake Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 231844 (87 days observed, edges closes)
note: Medicine Bow NF campground in the Snowy Range near Brooklyn Lake, ~10,500 ft (opens late, snow-dependent). 19 sites, 5 pull-throughs; vault toilets, no hookups; mix of reservable and first-come sites. Reservable online. --Claude

name: Fremont Lake
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 231912 (122 days observed, edges opens)
note: Bridger-Teton NF campground on the E shore of Fremont Lake, ~7 mi NE of Pinedale at ~7,400 ft. 49 sites (44 single/4 double/1 group), potable water, vault toilets, no hookups; boat ramp & dock on-site. Sites accommodate RVs/trailers ~30 ft+. Reservable online. --Claude

name: Hog Park Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 234141 (127 days observed, edges closes)
note: Medicine Bow-Routt NF, 50 sites in three loops on the SE shore of Hog Park Reservoir at ~8,400 ft, with boat ramp. 27 reservable sites (loops 1-2, to ~30 ft); the 22-site back loop is FCFS and recommended for tents/small campers (tight turning radius). Access is ~18 mi of washboard gravel. --Claude

name: Libby Creek Willow Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 10250594 (94 days observed, edges closes)
note: Medicine Bow-Routt NF, 16 sites in the Libby Creek Recreation Area off the Snowy Range Scenic Byway (Hwy 130 / FR-351) at ~8,600 ft, on Libby Creek. Mix of reservable and FCFS sites; seasonal hand-pump water. Trailers under ~22 ft (a 23-ft rig is borderline). --Claude

name: North Fork Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 231846 (116 days observed, edges closes)
note: Medicine Bow NF (Snowy Range), off FR101/Sand Lake Rd ~4 mi W of Centennial at ~9,200 ft on the North Fork of the Little Laramie River. 60 sites in two sections; some sites along the river. Reservable via recreation.gov. --Claude

name: Vedauwoo Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 10155998 (132 days observed, edges closes)
note: Medicine Bow NF, Pole Mountain unit at the Vedauwoo rock formations ~15 mi E of Laramie off I-80 (exit 329), ~8,200 ft. Drive-in sites accommodate trailers/RVs to ~32 ft, vault toilets, hand-pump water, no hookups. Reservable online. --Claude
